title: When not to use an article
goal: Drop the article with general ideas, meals and places like home
intro: Sometimes English uses no article at all. Talking about things in general (“Dogs are loyal”), meals, most languages and subjects, and some fixed places like home, school, work and bed. Adding “the” here is a common mistake.

rules.rule: General plural or uncountable nouns: no article.
Meals, languages, subjects, sports: no article.
examples: She speaks Tamil. He plays cricket.

rules.rule: go to school / work / bed / church; go home; at home; by bus / car / train.
examples: I go to work by bus.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to the home.
We had a lunch at one.

ex.q: I usually go to ___ at eleven.
My son goes to the school by the bus.
ex.fixed: My son goes to the school by bus.

ex.a: I usually go to work by metro.
ex.y: No article with work and by + transport.

ex.q: Correct this: “I am going to the home now.”

talk: Describe your normal weekday: when you have breakfast, how you go to work or college, and when you get home. Watch where you don’t need “the”.
